source: Orientation pieces recoloured by exact hex swap (executive_kit.py), shared pieces from shared_pieces.py, Executive-only pieces and the atrium tree landmark; build_executive.py

entries.name: floor_j
entries.note: Executive floor, slab corner: joint on the top row and the left column. Pale limestone, broad slabs, no grain

entries.name: floor_h

entries.name: floor_v

entries.name: floor_p

entries.name: floor_chip

entries.name: route_inlay

entries.name: route_inlay_v
entries.note: route_inlay turned 90 degrees: the same line for vertical corridor edges

entries.name: route_arrow_e

entries.name: route_arrow_n

entries.name: wall_n_window_a

entries.name: wall_n_window_b
entries.note: high window overlay, daylight state: dark frame, sky-blue pane, one stepped reflection band, lit sill. Phase a and b differ only in the band position

entries.name: wall_n_window_a_dim
entries.note: high window overlay, overcast state (before the third repair): flat dark panes, no reflection band, a dull sill. The daylight state is wall_n_window_a

entries.name: wall_n_window_b_dim
entries.note: high window overlay, overcast state (before the third repair): flat dark panes, no reflection band, a dull sill. The daylight state is wall_n_window_b

entries.name: wall_n_alcove

entries.name: wall_e_plain

entries.name: wall_n_trim
entries.note: copper picture rail for the north wall face, 16 x 3 px, lit top row, studs every 8 px; place at wall y 22 under the window overlays

entries.name: final_door_closed
entries.note: both glass leaves shut: copper frame, sky-glass leaves, seam, pulls, sunrise sign; a daylit terrace shows through

entries.name: final_door_half
entries.note: leaves slid 8 px into the jamb pockets: the terrace and its hedge show through

entries.name: final_door_open
entries.note: leaves fully in the pockets (15 px): the doorway is open and bright with daylight

entries.name: lamp
entries.note: floor lamp: dark post, copper lamp head with one lit step, contact shadow

entries.name: lamp_off
entries.note: unlit lamp: head in the ink ramp, no glow

entries.name: lamp_glow_on
entries.note: glow, one hard warm step (radius 5.2). Paints only where the floor is the bare fill #F1EEE6, so it never washes over joints, inlays, props or walls

entries.name: lamp_glow_pulse
entries.note: pulse frame of the glow, radius 6.4; alternate with lamp_glow_on at about 600 ms each

entries.name: partition_1x1

entries.name: partition_2x1

entries.name: terminal_desk

entries.name: cabinet_1x1

entries.name: cabinet_2x1

entries.name: light_shaft_cool
entries.note: overcast: two bands of pale sky light from a window pair, one hard step that barely lifts the floor; paints only on the bare floor fill, so shelves, desks and joints stay untouched. Place at the window's bottom-left; state set window_light switches between the two

entries.name: light_shaft_warm
entries.note: daylight: the same two bands once the window views resolve, one hard warm step; paints only on the bare floor fill, so shelves, desks and joints stay untouched. Place at the window's bottom-left; state set window_light switches between the two

entries.name: boardroom_table
entries.note: long boardroom table, 4 x 2 cells: walnut top plane with a copper inlay border, pale runner, papers at eight stations, water glasses and a conference puck, copper studs on the front face. Chairs are separate entries

entries.name: boardroom_chair
entries.note: dark navy high-back boardroom chair seen from above, copper stud row on the back; place 1 cell south of the table's south edge (or north of its north edge, mirrored by the layout)

entries.name: glass_rail_1x1
entries.note: glass balustrade, one cell: copper cap and base, pale pane, one reflection band, a post on the left edge; run several to edge an atrium well or mezzanine

entries.name: glass_rail_2x1
entries.note: glass balustrade, two cells, a post every cell

entries.name: glass_rail_side
entries.note: balustrade side run seen from above: a 6 px copper and glass edge, one cell tall; place down the east or west side of a well, the sprite sits centred in its cell

entries.name: atrium_well
entries.note: the sunken well: octagonal coping ring in the stone mid step, a shaded inner north face, a bright floor, a copper ring inlay around the planter and three steps down through the three-cell south gap

entries.name: atrium_inlay_before
entries.note: before: copper floor lines leave the well rigid and wandering, with right-angle jogs, knots and dead-end stubs that connect to nothing

entries.name: atrium_inlay_after
entries.note: after: the same lines straightened into three clean paths with chevrons, east, west and south, running to the box edge where the routes continue (levels.md 20: copper floor lines straighten into useful paths)

entries.name: atrium_planter
entries.note: raised round planter: pale stone face with a copper band, lit rim, dark soil, ground cover and two roots over the rim. Carries the collision of the whole well (rail ring, planter, open steps)

entries.name: atrium_nameplates_before
entries.note: before: five identical blank pale nameplates on the planter face

entries.name: atrium_nameplates_after
entries.note: after: the same five plates distinct: different widths, copper, navy and pale, each with its own inked mark (levels.md 20: nameplates become distinct)

entries.name: atrium_trunk
entries.note: slim walnut trunk with a root flare and a fork under the crown

entries.name: atrium_rail_back
entries.note: north, west and east runs of the glass balustrade: copper caps and bases, pale panes, posts every cell

entries.name: atrium_pots_before
entries.note: before: four corner pots with identical square-clipped box cubes (repeated geometry)

entries.name: atrium_pots_after
entries.note: after: the same four pots with soft shrubs of different sizes and copper blossoms (repeated geometry becomes varied)

entries.name: atrium_canopy
entries.note: the crown: nine leaf clusters in a tall oval with an airy skirt, a different silhouette from the garden's wide dome; separate part so a renderer can sway it

entries.name: atrium_canopy_shadow
entries.note: one cool stone step on the well floor, lower right of the planter

entries.name: atrium_rail_front
entries.note: south runs of the balustrade flanking the steps, with newel posts; drawn after actors so a person on the steps passes behind the rail ends

entries.name: atrium_daylight_after
entries.note: after: a warm pool of daylight on the well floor around the planter; paints only on the bare well floor (levels.md 20: window light warms)

entries.name: branch_name_before
entries.note: the Name branch's nameplate (level 20, The Name: a renamed department), a 40 x 12 copper wall plate. before: Pace's replacement, three orderly pale bars, no name. Place on the navy north wall face; the plain wall already blocks. Also the plate for the Names on the Wall side quest

entries.name: branch_name_after
entries.note: the Name branch's nameplate (level 20, The Name: a renamed department), a 40 x 12 copper wall plate. after: the department's original name in irregular lettering after a small crest. Place on the navy north wall face; the plain wall already blocks. Also the plate for the Names on the Wall side quest

entries.name: branch_route_before
entries.note: the Route branch's floor line (level 20, The Route: a rewarded detour), 4 x 2 cells in copper on the floor markings, west edge to east edge. before: an S of right angles with knots at the corners, a detour that is rewarded. Walkable; lay several end to end for a longer branch

entries.name: branch_route_after
entries.note: the Route branch's floor line (level 20, The Route: a rewarded detour), 4 x 2 cells in copper on the floor markings, west edge to east edge. after: one straight line with four chevrons pointing east. Walkable; lay several end to end for a longer branch

entries.name: branch_count_before
entries.note: the Count branch's tally board (level 20, The Count: a corrected total), 2 x 1 on two walnut feet: a pale panel with four sky-blue bars and a total plate. before: the total reads 47 in a dull plate and the bars do not add up

entries.name: branch_count_after
entries.note: the Count branch's tally board (level 20, The Count: a corrected total), 2 x 1 on two walnut feet: a pale panel with four sky-blue bars and a total plate. after: the corrected total 52 in a copper plate with a green tick

entries.name: place_ivo
entries.note: Ivo's place: a reception lectern with his tablet on the slanted top (level 20: an arriving coworker's place; the coworker arrives as a silhouette, then as a sprite, standing here), 1 x 1, blocks its cell

entries.name: place_noor
entries.note: Noor's place: a small walnut table with her stamp and a file tray of copper-tabbed folders (level 20: an arriving coworker's place; the coworker arrives as a silhouette, then as a sprite, standing here), 1 x 1, blocks its cell

entries.name: place_hal
entries.note: Hal's place: his folding stool with the tool roll leaning on it (the shared drawing, Executive ramps) (level 20: an arriving coworker's place; the coworker arrives as a silhouette, then as a sprite, standing here), 1 x 1, blocks its cell

entries.name: place_ada
entries.note: Ada's place: a copper lantern stand with a lit lantern on a hook arm (level 20: an arriving coworker's place; the coworker arrives as a silhouette, then as a sprite, standing here), 1 x 1, blocks its cell

entries.name: place_mira
entries.note: Mira's place: a round navy cushion with her courier satchel and its copper strap (level 20: an arriving coworker's place; the coworker arrives as a silhouette, then as a sprite, standing here), 1 x 1, blocks its cell

final_door.note: the last door, visible from the entrance; it opens after the third accurate repair. Same frames as Orientation's sliding door, recoloured; the doorway shows a daylit terrace

lamp.note: glow states: off, on (steady), pulse (wider ring). Wake = off -> on; idle breathing = on <-> pulse.

window_a.note: window views resolve into real daylight (levels.md 20): overcast flat panes, then the reflecting sky

window_b.note: the second reflection phase of window_a

window_light.note: the light shaft under a window pair: barely-there cool light, then warm daylight

branch_name.note: level 20, The Name: the renamed department gets its original name back. Pair with landmark state repaired_name (the planter's nameplates become distinct)

branch_route.note: level 20, The Route: the rewarded detour becomes a straight line. Pair with landmark state repaired_route (the atrium's copper lines straighten and the pots vary)

branch_count.note: level 20, The Count: the total is corrected. Pair with landmark state repaired_count and the window_a, window_b and window_light sets going to daylight

atrium_tree.note: Executive landmark: a tall single tree in a raised round planter, inside a sunken atrium well edged with a glass balustrade. Every part is a full-size sprite registered at one footprint origin, so a state is a list of parts; place them all at the same cell. The canopy is its own part (draws over the rail and the trunk); the south rail runs are front_prop so a person on the steps passes behind the newel posts. The three incident branches of level 20 can be done in any order, so besides before and after there is a state for every combination: repaired_name (The Name: the planter's nameplates become distinct), repaired_route (The Route: the copper floor lines straighten and the corner pots vary), repaired_count (The Count: the warm daylight pool and the lamps), and repaired_name_route, repaired_name_count, repaired_route_count. after is all three.
changes_after: the copper floor lines straighten into three clean paths with chevrons (levels.md 20: copper floor lines straighten into useful paths)
the five nameplates on the planter become distinct plates with their own marks (levels.md 20: nameplates become distinct)
the four corner pots go from identical clipped cubes to soft, varied shrubs with copper blossoms (levels.md district row: repeated geometry becomes varied)
a warm pool of daylight lights the well floor around the planter (levels.md 20: window light warms)
all four atrium lamps switch from the steady glow to the wider pulse glow
